svg.title: Vesper acceptance status
svg.desc: Named acceptance checks for the current local Vesper roadmap. Counts are not a percentage of vendor features, total engineering effort or detection resistance. verified: 56, source_tested: 9, in_progress: 8, planned: 27.

g.text: One tile = one named acceptance check. Source tests do not establish native-kernel or vendor parity.
The inventory grows as requirements become known. Open the checklist for the definition and evidence behind each tile.
